name: Connect IQ Dev (${localWorkspaceFolderBasename})
postStartCommand: echo "/home/${localEnv:USER}/connectiq-sdk-manager/bin/sdkmanager" > "/home/${localEnv:USER}/.Garmin/ConnectIQ/sdkmanager-location.cfg" && SDK_BIN="$CIQ_HOME/Sdks/$(ls $CIQ_HOME/Sdks 2>/dev/null | grep connectiq-sdk | head -1)/bin" && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && find "$SDK_BIN" -maxdepth 1 -type f -executable -exec ln -sf {} ~/.local/bin/ \; && echo "Dev container ready. SDK tools linked from $SDK_BIN into ~/.local/bin. SDK Manager at /home/${localEnv:USER}/connectiq-sdk-manager/bin/sdkmanager"
